title: Chronicle animation beats
description: Script-side output consumed by the Chronicle Animation design skill.

kicker.description: Small tracked label above the title, e.g. source and item count.

range.description: Display form of the span, e.g. "2009 — 2026".

opening.description: One sentence under the title. The thesis of the piece.

axis.description: First and last year on the vertical axis. Every year between is drawn.

chain.description: The metaphor words in order, for the breadcrumb and the closing stack. Subset of chapter words.

name.description: Unique ASCII timeline section id. Must match OM_SCENES. Never rename after delivery.

year.description: Anchor year. Drives the spine, not the marker.

word.description: The metaphor. 1-5 characters reads best at 104px.

y.description: Year of THIS quote. Required always. The axis marker follows this.

at.description: Seconds from chapter start. First ~1.0-1.2, second ~6.0-7.6.

text.description: Verbatim source text. Do not paraphrase.

date.description: Date plus context, e.g. "2011.07.20 · 落榜后一个月". Empty string to omit.

muted.description: Renders smaller at 62% — for asides and archive statistics, not voice.

name.description: Section id for the closing beat, e.g. "RootGrows".

closing.description: The final beat: the chain stacks, the spine keeps growing, no closing line.

accentDeep.description: For accent text at 22px and under. Needs ~6:1 on bg.

music.description: Path to a user-supplied audio file. Leave empty; never source copyrighted music.
